Response variable.reasoning: This column describes the dependent variable in the statistical model, not an organism's trait.

Predictor variable.reasoning: This column lists the independent variables (predictors) used in the statistical model.

Estimate.reasoning: This column holds the coefficient values (estimates) from the statistical regression.

SE/SD.reasoning: This column holds the Standard Error or Standard Deviation of the estimates.

Z value.reasoning: This column holds the Z-test statistic used for hypothesis testing.

P value.reasoning: This column holds the probability value (p-value) indicating statistical significance.
